title: Establish the handoff domain and storage contract
description: Implement the compatibility-sensitive foundation for retained handoffs. Add core.Handoff with canonical UUID id, optional canonical taskId, optional non-blank author, trimmed required message, and UTC createdAt validation. Add an optional omitempty handoffs field to TaskView without changing persisted task JSON. Define provider request/filter/result types for write, list, and purge operations. Add flat-file serialization helpers for .wtp/handoffs.json using the wrapper {"handoffs": [...]}, treating a missing file as an empty legacy-compatible store, rejecting malformed or duplicate records, and writing the whole collection atomically under the existing global lock. Keep the repository compiling and existing behavior green; do not add the CLI commands or complete CRUD behavior in this task.
